manualChecklistTemplates.title: Review risk analysis and security policy evidence

items.title: Confirm the risk analysis and information security policy are current
items.description: Attach the latest approved risk analysis or policy evidence.

items.title: Confirm open risks were reviewed by the assigned owner
items.description: Record review outcome and risk owner.

items.title: Triage open high-severity incidents and attach evidence
items.description: Record owner, status, and retained incident response evidence.

items.title: Validate incident reporting contacts
items.description: Confirm reporting contacts and escalation route are still valid.

manualChecklistTemplates.title: Review continuity, backup, and crisis evidence

items.title: Confirm backup and restore evidence is current
items.description: Attach restore test, backup status, or continuity review evidence.

items.title: Confirm crisis management contacts and roles are current
items.description: Record the latest continuity owner and escalation review.

manualChecklistTemplates.title: Review supplier and service-provider security evidence

items.title: Review direct supplier security risks
items.description: Attach supplier review notes, contract security clauses, or risk decisions.

manualChecklistTemplates.title: Review secure acquisition, development, and vulnerability handling

items.title: Confirm vulnerability handling and disclosure workflow is current
items.description: Attach vulnerability triage, disclosure, or patch-management evidence.

items.title: Review secure acquisition or change-management evidence
items.description: Record evidence for secure procurement, development, or maintenance controls.

items.title: Confirm effectiveness testing was performed
items.description: Attach test results, control review notes, or management sign-off.

manualChecklistTemplates.title: Review cyber hygiene and training evidence

items.title: Confirm cybersecurity training completion evidence
items.description: Attach training completion records or awareness attestation.

items.title: Review basic cyber hygiene baseline
items.description: Record password, patching, device, and safe-use practice review evidence.

manualChecklistTemplates.title: Review cryptography and encryption policy evidence

items.title: Confirm cryptography and encryption policy is current
items.description: Attach policy, standard, or secure-communications attestation.

manualChecklistTemplates.title: Review access control and asset management evidence

items.title: Review privileged roles and access assignments
items.description: Attach provider export, access review, or owner attestation.

items.title: Confirm asset inventory evidence is current
items.description: Attach device, application, or service inventory evidence.

items.title: Confirm privileged accounts are covered by MFA policy
items.description: Attach provider export or manual attestation for privileged MFA coverage.

controls.title: Risk analysis and information system security policies
controls.description: Maintain risk analysis and information system security policies as internal readiness evidence.

evidenceRequired.title: Approved risk analysis or information security policy
evidenceRequired.description: Current policy, risk register, or management-approved review evidence.

controls.title: Incident handling
controls.description: Maintain incident handling procedures, triage records, and source-linked evidence for significant security events.

evidenceRequired.title: Incident handling procedure or triage record
evidenceRequired.description: Incident response process, tabletop record, or retained incident triage evidence.

controls.title: Business continuity, backup management, disaster recovery, and crisis management
controls.description: Maintain continuity, backup, restore, disaster recovery, and crisis-management evidence for internal readiness.

evidenceRequired.title: Continuity, backup, restore, or crisis-management evidence
evidenceRequired.description: Current continuity plan, restore test, backup status, or crisis-management review evidence.

controls.title: Supply chain security
controls.description: Track security-related aspects of relationships with direct suppliers and service providers.

evidenceRequired.title: Supplier security review evidence
evidenceRequired.description: Supplier risk register, security clauses, due-diligence evidence, or review decision.

controls.title: Secure acquisition, development, maintenance, and vulnerability handling
controls.description: Maintain secure acquisition, development, maintenance, vulnerability handling, and disclosure evidence.

evidenceRequired.title: Secure change or vulnerability handling evidence
evidenceRequired.description: Secure acquisition, development, maintenance, patch, vulnerability triage, or disclosure evidence.

controls.title: Effectiveness assessment of cybersecurity risk-management measures
controls.description: Assess the effectiveness of cybersecurity risk-management measures and retain the review evidence.

evidenceRequired.title: Control effectiveness assessment evidence
evidenceRequired.description: Control test result, internal review, management sign-off, or audit-readiness evidence.

controls.title: Basic cyber hygiene practices and cybersecurity training
controls.description: Maintain basic cyber hygiene practices and cybersecurity training evidence for the workforce.

evidenceRequired.title: Cyber hygiene or training evidence
evidenceRequired.description: Training completion, awareness attestation, or basic hygiene review evidence.

controls.title: Cryptography and encryption policies and procedures
controls.description: Maintain cryptography and, where appropriate, encryption policies and procedures.

evidenceRequired.title: Cryptography or encryption policy evidence
evidenceRequired.description: Approved cryptography, encryption, or secure-communications policy evidence.

controls.title: Human resources security, access control policies, and asset management
controls.description: Maintain HR security, access control, privileged role, guest access, and asset-management evidence.

evidenceRequired.title: Access control and asset-management evidence
evidenceRequired.description: Privileged role review, guest access review, HR security, or asset inventory evidence.

controls.title: Multi-factor authentication and secure communications where appropriate
controls.description: Privileged access should be covered by MFA or equivalent strong authentication controls, with secure communications reviewed where appropriate.

evidenceRequired.title: Privileged MFA coverage evidence
evidenceRequired.description: Provider export, policy evidence, or manual attestation for privileged MFA coverage.
